# Source: https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/software/junos/vpn-ipsec/topics/topic-map/migrate-to-route-based-ipsec-vpn.html
# Page title: Migrate to Route-Based IPsec VPNs | Junos OS | Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-13
# Assumptions: PERMIT-OPT-1 (then permit tunnel, hierarchical format)
# Note: The policy-based VPN configuration shown before migration: two policies with then { permit { tunnel { ipsec-vpn NAME; } } } and literal prefixes as match addresses, as published.
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized, trailing spaces kept).
# ---
[edit security policies]
user@host# show
from-zone zone1 to-zone zone2 {
    policy policy1 {
        match {
            source-address 192.168.2.0/24;
            destination-address 10.0.2.0/24;
        }
        then {
            permit {
                tunnel {
                    ipsec-vpn vpn1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
from-zone zone3 to-zone zone4 {
    policy policy2 {
        match {
            source-address 192.168.3.0/24;
            destination-address 10.0.3.0/24;
        }
        then {
            permit {
                tunnel {
                    ipsec-vpn vpn2;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
